implementationScope: public resource-aware DecodedImage finalization adds non-consuming preflight resource authority; independent JPEG implementation remains package-only and the legacy value-only finalizer remains unadvertised
requiredInvariants: All v6 packed, no-copy DecodedImage, exact ImageProbe, source-binding, public-capability and framework-private resource facts remain unchanged.
Before consuming finalization, a resource-aware session at finalReady exposes the exact materialization resource ledger through decodedImageFinalizationResourceLedger().
Reading the preflight ledger is non-consuming: the qualification snapshot is byte-for-byte unchanged before and after the preflight call.

The preflight ledger preserves operationPeak = unknown(frameworkPrivateOperationAllocation), transfer = 897 bytes and codecOwnedRGB8 layout authority; a bounded host can therefore reject before Core Graphics materialization runs.
The consuming finalization must return exactly the same materialization ledger that was exposed by preflight.
The independent JPEG backend remains package-only and still does not advertise ProgressiveImageFinalizingSession.
